_doc: Research Bot containment (Item 320 Part 6, 29 Oct 2026). Read by bot.py on every run; never remembered.
ceiling_note: 200 reads per day is the Chair's ruled figure, assumed, not measured; every report citing it says so
kill_switch_note: a file named bot-kill in the working directory halts the run before the next read; the audit log is intact to the halt

blast_radius.rows_touched: only rows the run is given, never the working file
blast_radius.fields_written: addr_found, bot_note, bot_status — on queue entries only; never a row's address, phone, decision maker, tier, status or note
blast_radius.what_total_failure_costs: at most one day's ceiling of reads (200) spent, and a queue of unconfirmed proposals; nothing in florida.html, florida-standard.json, florida-outreach.json or suppression.json changes, because the bot cannot write to them
blast_radius.how_it_is_reversed: delete the queue file; the audit log records every read so the same rows are not re-read within the window

window.ruled: window three, rulings 6–10 and the Chair’s addition (Part 5)
